descriptionHtml:
Approach · EFS Empty & Failure States · S10 Ask AI fails in both contexts: explicit error, no answer, no earlier answer left under the new question, the typed question is kept

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 Ask AI failed: an explicit error and no invented answer. (UAT EFS state 6; TFA-94745 state 6)
  • U11 Every state shows a clear, plain-language message in the app's existing style that tells the physician what to do next (retry, enable permission, sign in, check connection). (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 1; TFA-94745 AC 5)
  • U12 No state ever shows a blank screen, a crash, a raw error pop-up, or invented content. (UAT EFS intro; UAT 3.4; TFA-94745 AC 2)
  • U13 Nothing the physician dictated or typed is lost in any failure state. (UAT EFS Expected Result; TFA-94745 AC 3)
  • U14 Every state works in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android. (UAT EFS Expected Result; UAT 3.3; TFA-94745 AC 6)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Standard fixture (no labs on either chart); the harness answers the first ai/assist:askChart call of each sheet with a fixed reply and fails every later call

When Open Ask AI on the Hospital Pre-Round tab, ask 'What is the diagnosis?' (answered), then type the test question and ask (fails); then the same on the Nursing Home Encounter tab

Then After the failure the sheet says there is no answer and what to do; no answer text, no lab value, and the first answer is no longer shown as if it answered the second question; the second question is still in the box

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): From U6/U13: cp-answered mustContain the fixed reply (the mock works); cp-failed mustContain 'QA-EFS-10 which labs came back today?' — no chip holds it and the sheet does not echo the question, so only the textbox value can match (the textbox line carries a [ref=…] before its value, so the reviewer's 'textbox "…": value' string would never match) — plus one failure word and on …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method PW · Playwright script; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/EFS.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: PW · Playwright script; secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: newspec-c.

UAT item: EFS Empty & Failure States · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: EFS/S10

Ask AI fails in both contexts: explicit error, no answer, no earlier answer left under the new question, the typed question is kept

Tickets: TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

New local lane newspec-c: status passed in newspec-c/results.json → passed (passed).

Detail:

Hospital (Ask opened from Pre-Round) and Nursing Home (from Encounter); spec newspec-c/flt-efs-s10-ask-fail.spec.ts. ai/assist:askChart answered at the socket: the first question 'What is the diagnosis?' with 'QA-EFS-10-A1 fixed first answer.', the second typed question 'QA-EFS-10 which labs came back today?' fails. Judged 18/18. After the failure the sheet says 'The chart assistant couldn’t be reached, so there is no answer. Nothing shown here is a stand-in. Check your connection and tap Ask AI again.'; the second question is still in the box; the first answer is gone; no 'Patient Record' answer block; no lab word (WBC, creatinine, Hgb, potassium, mg/dL, mmol) anywhere on screen; not left on 'Searching…'.

Evidence: 6 attached.

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: fault-ai. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
